copy.question: Do I need a lawyer after a minor crash?
copy.answer: Not always. But if you were hurt, missed work or the insurer is pushing you to settle fast, it's worth a free conversation first.

cover.label: After a crash
cover.headline: 5 things to do after a car accident

slides.title: Get to safety and call 911
slides.text: Move out of traffic if you can. Report the crash.

slides.title: Photograph everything
slides.text: Vehicles, the scene, injuries and road conditions.

slides.title: See a doctor the same day
slides.text: Some injuries show up hours later.

slides.text: Waiting can hurt your health and your claim.
